name: What are common accessible appliance features for a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What are common accessible appliance features for a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessible kitchen appliances often feature front-mounted controls for easy reach, side-opening or pull-out oven doors, and induction or smooth cooktops for safer use. Dishwashers may be drawer-style or raised to reduce bending. Refrigerators with side-by-side doors or bottom-freezer drawers are often preferred. Look for appliance models that meet ADA guidelines for usability, ensuring controls are within reach and operable with minimal force.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessible appliances feature front controls, side-opening oven doors, smooth cooktops, and pull-out or raised dishwashers for easier use.
